findings.label: Geocoding drops provinceless PH results
findings.detail: The filter requires typeof item.admin1 === "string" in addition to country_code === "PH", so valid PH places that lack a province field are silently excluded (user sees the "Walang nahanap" state). The requirement is to filter to country_code === PH only. Consider keeping the hit with admin1: "" and letting the display fall back to the bare name.

findings.label: PAGASA mapping is a safe stub
findings.detail: fetchPagasaWeather returns null even when a key is set; the TenDay response is never mapped (marked 'needs verification during implementation'). The silent Open-Meteo fallback is airtight and this is acknowledged in the plan, but source: 'PAGASA' and the 'Ayon sa PAGASA' attribution are unreachable until the mapping is completed.

findings.label: layout.tsx edited despite plan item 18
findings.detail: The diff touches layout.tsx (ThemeProvider + no-flash theme script + metadata), which plan item 18 said not to edit. The change is prior-cycle theme scaffolding, not M2, and preserves fonts; confirm it belongs in this commit rather than being an accidental carry-in. AGENTS.md managed block is intact.
